title: Marketing Analyst Intern
description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Analyst Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Marketing Analyst Intern, you'll be a direct extension of the marketing team— owning research, tracking, and analytical work that powers our biggest consumer programs. Your day-to-day will involve execution & analysis around three pillars: giveaways, surveys, and special marketing projects. You'll bring structure to fast-moving campaigns, surface insights from data, and use AI tools to work smarter and faster. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and has a strong bias for action. This role is tailored for a data-savvy, results-oriented candidate seeking exposure to campaign execution, data and performance analytics.

What You’ll Do:

Campaign Execution and Operations

  • Support end-to-end execution of consumer giveaway campaigns. Coordinating with crossfunctional team members to take the campaign from idea to live in-market. Support in goal setting for campaigns, based on historical data.
  • Analyze post-campaign performance report and summary results for the marketing team. Provide learnings & recommendations to improve results for future campaigns.
  • Analyze top performing communication, creative & channel for ongoing optimization in CRM Tool ( e.g Braze)
  • Compare performance across time periods (e.g. pre/post campaign, week-over-week) and flag meaningful shifts

Performance Analysis and Reporting

  • Monitor and report on campaign performance using dashboards and structured reporting templates. Key metrics include: DAU, NTM,LTV, CAC, Open/Click-through/Conversion Rates
  • Initiative & support Assist data pull & recommendation on optimizing future campaigns

General Marketing Projects

  • Track campaign & merchant performance across channels and flag optimization opportunities to support DAU & App Conversion
  • Partner with the Merchant team to identify opportunities to collaborate with marketing to drive app installs directly from merchants.
  • Conduct market research comparing our programs against industry standards with competitor analysis

What We'll look for:

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in data-driven marketing practices with the ability to synthesize insights from campaign performance reports.
  • Foundational experience in tools such as redash/SIA (or similar business intelligence tools), Excel/Google Sheets, Braze and Confluence
  • Enthusiastic about using AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, or similar — as part of your daily workflow with ability to accelerate research, draft copy, summarize findings, and build first-pass analyses while understanding when human judgment takes over.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds.

Educational & Professional Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Background in marketing, analytics,or related fields.
  • Previous internships or academic projects involving campaign management and marketing analytics
  • Basic project management skills.
  • Experience leveraging data to tell a story and make decisions.

About You:

  • Analytical Thinker: You excel at using logic, data, and patterns to inform decisions and strategies.
  • Self-Starter: Is known for taking initiative in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Able to distill complex updates for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-Oriented Executor: Your accuracy ensures campaign quality and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Customer-Centric Innovator: You’re passionate about crafting messages that matter to specific audiences and segments.
  • Team Player - A+ character with a team mentality. We are team-first here at Sezzle. Willing to support where the team needs help.

Why Sezzle?

Sezzle is a mission-driven fintech innovator aiming to empower the next generation with smarter financial tools. We value diverse perspectives and a growth mindset, and our team is a vibrant mix of technologists, marketers, creatives, and analysts. At Sezzle, interns are treated as full contributors—expected to bring data-backed thinking, challenge assumptions, and propose novel solutions.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

Sezzle is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing Analyst Intern is $2.800.000 COP monthly.
